evidence.detail: c.update(cards[c.name]) raises KeyError if a card name in _rotation is absent from oracle.cards_by_name()
Old redis-backed system used cs.get(name) which returns None gracefully for missing cards — explicit robustness the new code lost
Introduced the decksite DB caching layer; the new load_rotation replaced the .get() pattern with direct dict access

triage.fix_sketch: In `decksite/data/rotation.py` around line 41, change the loop to `card_data = cards.get(c.name); if card_data: c.update(card_data) else: logger.warning(...)`. This restores the same graceful handling the old code had when a rotation-file card name is not yet in the oracle (e.g. immediately after a set release before the DB is updated).
